q: Pali's hand process and power process units use very different energy: which records matter for each?
title: Pali hand vs power process: energy records
short: A Pali power process unit burns about 5 to 7 t of pet coke a day and uses around 3,000 kWh, so its boiler fuel log decides its carbon. A hand process unit heats dye pots over wood or briquettes with little power, so the fuel type and weight matter more than the meter.
audience: Dyeing and printing units in Pali's industrial areas and Mandia Road

ul: Power process: jet dyeing, stenters and boilers or thermopacks, mostly for man-made fibre. 40,000 to 50,000 metres a day.
Hand process: fabric soaked and heated in pots over wood or briquettes, mostly manual. 10,000 to 15,000 metres a day.
Most of the cluster's more than 350 member units are hand process.
The whole cluster turned out about 55 lakh metres a day and used over 51 crore kWh in 2007-08.
Pet coke (residual pet coke) receipts and daily boiler feed, in tonnes. Units moved to it when Gujarat lignite stopped.
Electricity bills: a typical unit used over 75,000 kWh a month.
Metres or kg processed per day, from the dispatch register.
Weight of wood, briquettes or coal bought, and which it was. Smaller units burn 1,000 to 1,500 kg a day.
Wood and briquettes count as biogenic CO2, reported separately; coal counts in full.
Printing units' power: 160 to 500 kWh a day.
Metres processed, even if only from job cards.

sections.h: Why the split matters to a buyer
p: A garment brand asking for kg CO2 per metre will get very different answers from the two kinds of unit. Report fuel by type, not as one fuel bill total, so a biogenic fire is not counted as coal.

example.title: One day in each kind of unit (estimate)
lines: Power process: 6 t pet coke x 3.17 = 19.0 t CO2, plus 3,000 kWh x 0.675 = 2.0 t
21.0 t / 45,000 metres = about 0.47 kg CO2 per metre
Smaller unit on 1.25 t of coal: 1.25 x 1.76 = 2.2 t CO2 a day
Same unit on 1.25 t of wood: fossil CO2 near zero; the wood's CO2 goes in a separate biogenic line
example.note: Daily quantities from BEE's Pali cluster manual (2007-09 data); pet coke and coal factors from IPCC 2006 and India's BUR-2. Your own logs replace them.

senseible: Senseible reads pet coke, coal and wood invoices by fuel type and keeps biogenic fuel on its own line, so your carbon number per metre separates the two.
